<solution_file path="src/t02_load_eurostat.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

# Paths
SELECTED_INDICATORS_PATH = "outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv"
EUROSTAT_DATA_PATH = "inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv"
OUTPUT_PATH = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)

# Load selected indicators
selected_df = pd.read_csv(SELECTED_INDICATORS_PATH)
selected_indicator_ids = set(selected_df["indicator_id"].unique())

# Load eurostat city values
eurostat_df = pd.read_csv(EUROSTAT_DATA_PATH)

# Filter to only selected indicators
eurostat_df = eurostat_df[eurostat_df["indicator_id"].isin(selected_indicator_ids)]

# Ensure value is numeric (coerce errors to NaN, then drop non-numeric)
eurostat_df["value"] = pd.to_numeric(eurostat_df["value"], errors="coerce")
eurostat_df = eurostat_df.dropna(subset=["value"])

# Remove duplicates based on city_id, year, indicator_id (keep first)
eurostat_df = eurostat_df.drop_duplicates(subset=["city_id", "year", "indicator_id"], keep="first")

# Select and order output columns
output_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year", "indicator_id", "indicator_name", "value", "unit"]
eurostat_df = eurostat_df[output_columns]

# Write RFC 4180 compliant CSV
eurostat_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_PATH, index=False, quoting=1)  # quoting=1 is csv.QUOTE_ALL

print(f"Written {len(eurostat_df)} rows to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
</solution_file>
